lines: Now the big question — which path do you start on? Let's make it simple.
Remember, Apex gives you two ladders. Technology, and Insurance. You can run one, or both.
The Technology path is open to everyone. No license needed. You start earning right away.
You put Apex's A.I. tools in the hands of businesses, and earn on every subscription.
The Insurance path is for licensed agents. If you're licensed, you can sell policies too.
Not licensed yet? No problem. Start on Technology today, and get licensed when you're ready.
Here's the simple rule. Start where you can win this week, and add the second ladder later.
Whatever you choose, the team you build carries across. You're never starting over.
So pick your starting ladder, and commit to it. Momentum beats perfection.
Path chosen? Great. Next, we dive into the products you'll offer. Let's go.
